consequence.statement: An exposed environment keeps working, but Envoy silently stops requiring client certificates from pods on L7 policies using TLS termination because the ca.crt key of the secret is no longer loaded.
consequence.remediation: Set --use-full-tls-context=true to retain the previous (bug-compatible) behaviour.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.16, an L7 network policy with terminatingTLS no longer loads the ca.crt key of the referenced secret, so Envoy no longer requires client certificates from pods during TLS termination; the previous behaviour is retained only by setting --use-full-tls-context=true.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The exposure requires an 'L7 network policy with terminatingTLS' whose secret contains the ca.crt key, but the evidence names no resource group/kind, field path or secret-reading predicate that could express that condition (only the escape-hatch flag --use-full-tls-context=true is named), so no predicate can be written from the evidence.
